label: CHANCE_2, varying set-up: the giving and the giver's set-up both differ at an accessible world
definition: SetupVariationAt F A w y: y exists at w, and at some world v accessible from w where y exists, y's giving differs and its set-up differs (not SetupSameIn A y w v).
note: Analyst definition, attribution deferred (docs/notes/will-versus-chance.md). Deterministic or statistical chance. Example: a coin toss whose outcome tracks varying initial conditions. It does not require that the set-up difference determines the outcome. Excluded at an invariant set-up (Model.Laws 1).
